display_name: 独立时频学生七景正式测试
description: 从零训练独立时频恢复网络，以合法源 clean IQ 和冻结 DURA 源波形教师共同监督；部署仅输入接收 IQ，不调用 DURA、分类器或辅助编码器。

data.representation: frozen candidate + frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL on fixed Phase1 seven-view ground IQ
data.tx_sets_ref: No target labels, clean pair, or target fitting during inference; labels only after all seven predictions

roles.L_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.U_s: source IQ training only, TX hidden
roles.test: fixed Phase1 ground IQ, truth last

data.target_panel: 168000 Phase1 physical records x seven views
data.actual_training_labels: Recovery training uses paired source IQ only; no F outputs, F weights, TX labels, V or target. Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL only after recovery checkpoint frozen.
data.augmentation: Fixed pre-existing Phase1 ground test simulated seven views

permissions.query_use: Fixed per-record Phase1 IQ only after source training; no target fit, truth only after seven-view predictions
permissions.claim_scope: Single-seed repeatedly observed Phase1 simulated ground test; not independent blind or real satellite

checkpoint.initialization: Independently initialized 117062-parameter direct spectral student with zero output heads; source-only original DURA v1.0 provides IQ teacher during source training only
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura checks original DURA data contract; deterministic source cache verifies same 8192 fit IDs and fixed paired source simulations; student source target access is forbidden
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed original DURA is source-only IQ teacher, student independently initialized, no target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed final epoch 20; no source or target performance selection

metric_names: raw clean gap in pp and relative percent

rows.method: Received-IQ-only multiscale spectral direct student trained with normalized clean-IQ error plus 0.5 frozen DURA source-IQ teacher error
rows.purpose: Complete mandatory Phase1 seven-view test and paired DURA comparison
rows.seed_notes: Student initialization 2026110612, source fit 2026110611, shuffle 2026110613, frozen DURA seed 2026092701; no target selection.
rows.scenario: clean and six practical Phase1 Main split views

notes: Student begins from identity on received IQ, has multiscale spectral encoder/decoder and dynamic complex/conjugate 9-tap correction, and ignores all external context at inference.
Train objective is normalized IQ error to the paired source clean waveform plus 0.5 normalized IQ error to frozen DURA source teacher; original DURA and teacher cache are source-only.
No TX labels, F weights/outputs, V or target IQ/truth in source training; source DURA teacher is not an F teacher.
Fixed deterministic training, source context cache, 20 epochs; source results never cancel the predetermined full seven-view test.
Ground scoring uses frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL default head and computes original DURA separately solely for paired comparison; student deployment itself does not require DURA.
Record one-time DURA teacher/cache preparation and student training separately; no time/accuracy success claim before measurement.
